description: React component for displaying and managing defect details, including fetching defect data, updating status, uploading images, and downloading defect PDF.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest defect data from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the defect status via the API and refreshes defect data.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Uploads an image related to the defect and refreshes defect data.
